properties.short_description: Roomy modern performing-arts venue in Clearwater hosting music, comedy and Broadway productions, plus arts education programs.
properties.overall_description: Ruth Eckerd Hall is a premier performing-arts venue in Clearwater, widely celebrated for its superior acoustics, comfortable seating, and clear sight lines. It hosts a diverse range of programming including concerts, comedy, Broadway shows, and community events in a modern, well-maintained environment. With its dedicated, friendly staff, accessible facilities, and convenient parking, it remains a favorite destination for both locals and tourists seeking high-quality live entertainment.
properties.ambience_description: The atmosphere is welcoming and comfortable, offering an intimate yet lively environment perfect for enjoying live performances. The venue is consistently praised for being well-maintained and professionally managed.
properties.amenities_description: The venue provides comprehensive amenities including full-service bars, concession stands, and on-site dining options, alongside accessible features like elevators and ample parking.
properties.unique_selling_points: Renowned for its acoustically perfect hall, the venue provides an intimate viewing experience with excellent sight lines from any seat in the house.
properties.neighborhood_description: The surrounding area is a convenient and accessible location that supports a steady flow of visitors attending various shows and community events.
properties.physical_setting_description: A modern, roomy performing-arts venue located in Clearwater that features a beautiful exterior and a spacious, comfortable interior. The facility is well-integrated into a commercial area with ample, easily accessible parking.

properties.short_description: Historic 1921 art-deco theater in downtown Clearwater hosting concerts, theater, comedy and films, with VIP boxes, rooftop terrace, concessions and expanded seating.
properties.overall_description: The Nancy and David Bilheimer Capitol Theatre is a premier historic destination in downtown Clearwater, originally opened in 1921. Meticulously restored to retain its art-deco character while incorporating modern upgrades, it serves as an intimate venue for concerts, comedy, and theater. The theater features a rooftop terrace, VIP amenities, and excellent acoustics, all located within a highly walkable district filled with dining options.
properties.ambience_description: The venue offers an intimate and charming atmosphere, blending 1920s historical elegance with modern amenities like a rooftop lounge. It provides a cozy, close-up experience where guests often feel a personal connection to the performers.
properties.amenities_description: The theater features modern conveniences including a rooftop terrace, a VIP lounge, and multiple concession stands offering a full bar and snacks. The facility also includes updated lobby spaces, private loge boxes, and clean, well-maintained restrooms.
properties.unique_selling_points: As one of Florida's oldest operating theaters, this venue offers a rare combination of 1921 art-deco historic charm and modern performance technology. Its intimate size ensures that all 777 seats provide an up-close, immersive experience with the performers.
properties.neighborhood_description: The theater is located in a vibrant downtown area filled with numerous restaurants, bars, and local shops within easy walking distance. It is positioned in a central, accessible hub that encourages pre-show dining and exploration.
properties.physical_setting_description: Constructed in 1921, this historic art-deco theater is situated in the heart of the Cleveland Street District in downtown Clearwater. It features an outdoor balcony overlooking the Clearwater Causeway and a rooftop terrace.

properties.short_description: Casual local craft brewery and taproom in Safety Harbor offering rotating draft beers and a relaxed neighborhood atmosphere.
properties.overall_description: Crooked Thumb Brewery is a casual, neighborhood craft brewery in Safety Harbor that emphasizes a relaxed, community-driven experience. The space features both an indoor garage-style taproom and a large, fenced-in outdoor area that frequently hosts live music and food trucks. Known for its wide variety of craft beers ranging from IPAs to fruit-infused sours, it serves as a popular destination for locals and visitors seeking a chill, social atmosphere. The venue is notably dog-friendly and acts as a central hub for those looking to unwind in a laid-back, unpretentious setting.
properties.ambience_description: The atmosphere is notably relaxed and social, often described as a chill gathering spot where locals congregate for drinks and live entertainment.
properties.amenities_description: The facility features a spacious fenced outdoor area with a stage for live music and a garage-style indoor taproom. Rotating local food trucks are also frequently available on-site.
properties.unique_selling_points: This brewery is known for its authentic community vibe and a diverse selection of craft beers, including IPAs and sours, all served in an open, dog-friendly space.
properties.neighborhood_description: Situated off the main road in a quaint community, the area offers a relaxed, small-town atmosphere that feels like a hidden local gem.
properties.physical_setting_description: Located in the quiet village of Safety Harbor, this brewery features a casual, laid-back setting that includes an open-air garage space and a fenced-in outdoor yard.

properties.description: 5,509-seat stadium hosting Toronto Blue Jays spring training and Class-A Dunedin Blue Jays, with renovated seating, concessions, bars, and kids' activity areas.
properties.short_description: 5,509-seat stadium hosting Toronto Blue Jays spring training and Class-A Dunedin Blue Jays, with renovated seating, concessions, bars, and kids' activity areas.
properties.overall_description: TD Ballpark is a premier, renovated baseball facility located in downtown Dunedin, Florida, serving as the spring training home for the Toronto Blue Jays and the regular venue for the Dunedin Blue Jays. Known for its intimate layout, the stadium ensures every fan has an excellent view of the field while enjoying a wide selection of concessions, bars, and kid-friendly entertainment zones. The venue is highly regarded for its clean, safe, and family-oriented environment, making it a beloved destination for local residents and visiting tourists alike. Whether attending a high-stakes spring training game or a relaxed minor league event, guests can count on a memorable experience defined by great energy and professional service.
properties.ambience_description: The atmosphere is energetic and social, providing a classic, fun-filled environment perfect for enjoying baseball. It is characterized by friendly staff, clean facilities, and a community-oriented spirit.
properties.amenities_description: The stadium offers a variety of amenities including multiple concession stands, on-site bars, and dedicated play areas for children. Guests also have access to a team merchandise shop and well-maintained public restrooms.
properties.unique_selling_points: As the official home of Toronto Blue Jays spring training, this stadium is uniquely positioned to offer an intimate, high-quality baseball viewing experience where every seat provides an excellent vantage point.
properties.neighborhood_description: The ballpark is situated in a walkable and friendly area, making it easy for visitors to access local downtown shops and dining. It is surrounded by a safe community that contributes to a relaxed and welcoming game-day vibe.
properties.physical_setting_description: Located in the heart of Dunedin, this renovated 5,509-seat baseball stadium serves as the primary home for spring training and minor league games. The facility features a clean, well-maintained concourse with a mix of open and covered seating areas.
